answer: Each sitting costs a 2-day inspection visit that cannot be delegated or shortened, and the bridge is that the test is taken in person, with no stand-in and no recording to replay. Show the skill, not the paperwork: Conferred cartwright workshop registration under the cartwrights council tests each name live, since a registration wrights keep after axle audits. One honest agent passes once; a farm must pass a hundred live sittings, and the wharf is that every failure burns the fee while the vault stays out of reach.
